blocks.text:
MERGE
INTO TEAM T
USING TEAM_TWP S
ON (T.TEAM_ID = S.TEAM_ID)
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE
SET T.REGION_NAME = S.REGION_NAME
, T.TEAM_NAME = S_TEAM_NAME
, T.DDD = S.DDD
, T.TEL = S.TEL;
